affected.note: About 5.26 million customer records of the Kuroneko deferred-payment service (about 490,000 of them include email addresses). In addition, about 50,000 delivery recipient records and about 4,100 merchant records were taken; Kyodo reported the combined total as about 5.31 million. Credit card data and passwords are not included.

summary.en: Yamato Transport confirmed on 2026-09-28 that its Kuroneko deferred-payment service had been accessed without authorization by a third party. Its investigation found that about 5.26 million customer records, about 50,000 recipient records and about 4,100 merchant records had been taken.
summary.ja: ヤマト運輸は2026年9月28日、「クロネコ代金後払いサービス」が第三者による不正アクセスを受けたことを確認した。調査の結果、利用者情報約526万件、お届け先情報約5万件、加盟店情報約4,100件が不正に持ち出されたことが判明した。
